model.line: No box of its own: the hall drawn at this point stands for the gate in the 3D view.

facts.value: South wall. Written 福元门 on the plan; Malone's Fu Yuan Men, 'Happy Garden Gate' (S02), in the outside wall just south of group 40 and 300 yards east of the Great Palace Gate. Plan distance to G01: 1635 px.
